Keyphrase generation (KPG) is the task of automatically predicting such keyphrases given the source text.

Keyphrases are phrases that summarize and highlight important information in a piece of text. Keyphrase generation (KPG) is the task of automatically predicting such keyphrases given the source text. The task can be (and has often been) easily misunderstood and trivialized as yet another natural language generation task like summarization and translation...
models: RNN (GRU-based Seq2Seq with copy and coverage)
outputs: A set of keyphrases (multi-word phrases) generated for each source text.

We use F1@5, F1@10, F1@O and F1@M to evaluate a model's performance. Additionally, we provide an average score for each of the 4 metrics over all datasets... For absent keyphrase generation tasks we use R@10 and R@50.

Due to the multiplicity of targets in KPG task, the evaluation protocols are distinct from typical NLG tasks. A spectrum of evaluation metrics have been used to evaluate KPG systems, including metrics that truncate model outputs at a fixed number such as F1@5 and F1@10... metrics that evaluate a model's ability of generating variant number of phrases such as F1@O... metrics that evaluate absent keyphrases such as Recall@50 (R@50).
